model: TSF400-4 water-leak detector with Modbus RTU
applies_to: TSF400-4 per the Teracom TSF400-4 user manual Revision R1.2.
summary: The TSF400-4 is a Teracom floor-standing water-leak detector with five electrodes on its base and a Modbus RTU RS-485 interface. It reports the leak state as a normal and an inverted flag, in both holding and input registers.

addressing.note: The register table prints both a PDU (wire) address and a logical address (PDU + 40001 for holding registers). 'documented' holds the logical number; the PDU number is what goes in the request, e.g. logical 40101 = PDU 100.

notes: Addresses are taken from the manual's PDU address column (0-based); the logical column adds 40001 for holding registers and 30001 for input registers, as the manual states.
All 32-bit values follow the Data order register (PDU 13): 1 = most significant word first (factory default), 2 = least significant word first. The map shows the default, ABCD.
Left out: the 32-bit float/integer test-value registers (PDU 82-95), which only exist to check word order; the 16-bit test values are kept.
The same two alarm flags are readable as holding registers (PDU 100, 102) and as input registers (PDU 1, 2); the normal flag reads 1 when the floor is dry.
The device has no 32-bit measurement registers; the Data order register only affects the test values.

integration.summary: Poll PDU 102 with function 03 (1 = water present) or input register PDU 2 with function 04. Mind the polarity of the non-inverted flag.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU is the only interface and is always active; there is nothing to switch on. Factory settings are address 1, 19200 baud, 8E1.
quirks: Baud rate and framing changes only take effect after the device is powered off and on again.
Word order for every 32-bit value is set by the Data order register (PDU 13); check it before blaming the scaling.
setup: Set unit ID (PDU 10), baud (PDU 11) and framing (PDU 12), then power-cycle the device.
Terminate both ends of the RS-485 bus with 120 ohm resistors; a daisy chain is recommended.
gotchas: The non-inverted Alarm flag is 1 when no water is present, so treat a comms timeout as a fault rather than as dry.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
